search_text: published ZDI-11-325 ZDI-CAN-1225 HP Data Protector Notebook Extension GetPolicies Remote SQL Injection Vulnerabilty 2011-11-07 CVE-2011-3157 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2011-3157 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:P ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['Data Protector'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP Data Protector Notebook Extension. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The flaw exists within the dpnepolicyservice component which exposes a DPNECentral Web Service on TCP port 80. This service contains a method GetPolicies which does not properly validate or sanitize the clientVersion field of a user supplied request. This value is later used when constructing a query to fulfill the provided request. A remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary queries under the context of the service. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: HP Data Protector Notebook Extension GetPolicies Remote SQL Injection Vulnerabilty
